scope: 164 sampled centerline poses, two leads, connected/parked ends, canonical system-cover path. Monitor upper-shell movement leaves the captive lead ends unchanged. Nominal radius, not a manufacturer bend specification: minimum centerline radius must exceed twice the modeled cable radius and direction changes stay below 30 degrees per sample. Tube cross sections are rotated rigidly. Every line segment between sampled centers also stays outside the lid bounding box expanded by cable radius. Leads disconnect and travel with the monitor. Rear slack redistributes at constant modelled length (0.01 unit tolerance). Neither cable length nor disassembly sequence has specimen verification. Fixed chassis panel and PSU envelopes are also checked. No continuous-pose, full monitor shell, cable-to-cable or real slack/strain certification.
